analysis.headline: We Don't Sell Your Data
analysis.quote: For the record, we do not rent, sell, or otherwise transfer personal information.

analysis.headline: Excludes Affiliate Data Collection
analysis.quote: It does not apply to information collected by: Us offline or through any other means, including on any other website operated by Company or any third party (including our affiliates and subsidiaries); or Any third party (including our affiliates and subsidiaries), including through any application or content (including advertising) that may link to or be accessible from or on the Website.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Internationally
analysis.quote: Please be aware that your Information, including, but not limited to, your Personal Information and Billing Information, may be transferred to, processed, maintained, and used on computers, servers, and systems located outside of your state, province, country, or other governmental jurisdiction where the privacy laws may not be as protective as those in your jurisdiction.

analysis.headline: You Consent to International Transfer
analysis.quote: If you are located outside the United States and choose to use the Platform or Website, you hereby consent to such transfer, processing, and use in the United States and elsewhere.

analysis.headline: No Under 13s Allowed
analysis.quote: Our Website is not intended for children under 13 years of age. No one under age 13 may provide any information to or on the Website.

analysis.headline: You Share Security Responsibility
analysis.quote: You are also responsible for the privacy and security of your data. You are in charge of safeguarding any password we may have provided you (or that you may have chosen) for access to particular areas of our website.

analysis.headline: Your Data Security Not Guaranteed
analysis.quote: Even though we try our best to safeguard your personal information, we cannot ensure its security while submitted to our website. Personal information is sent at the sender's own risk.

analysis.headline: Policy Can Change Without Notice
analysis.quote: Your continued use of this Website after we make changes is deemed to be acceptance of those changes, so please check the policy periodically for updates.

analysis.headline: Your Marketing Opt-Out Unneeded
analysis.quote: However, please note that we do not currently sell data, nor do we share information with third parties in any way that would trigger the statute’s opt-out requirements.
